svg.title: Chronological training, validation and test forecast-origin intervals with five origins purged before each new sample
svg.desc: Chronological training, validation and test forecast-origin intervals with five origins purged before each new sample. Training origins 20–714 have labels ending at day 719; validation origins start at 720. The final five observations lack a five-day-ahead label. Lower panel enlarges the first boundary.

Synthetic sample: 1200 prices | Horizon 5 days | Hedge fit: prices 0–719
Also purge origins 955–959; origins 1195–1199 have no final labels. Overlapping targets are dependent.
